title: Doobi hui lahu me pyaso ki daastaa_n hai
body:
Doobi hui lahu me pyaaso ki daastaa'n hai
dushman hue musalmaa'n bedard aasmaa'n hai
Laila sambhaal lena akbar ki laash jaakar
shabbir hai akele mayyat badi jawaa'n hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Farmate hai shahedee'n akbar se deejo beta
aashoor ki hai sub'ha aur aaqri azaa'n hai
qoo'n me tadap raha hai kadyal jawaan beta
ae darde dil sambhal jaa ye waqte imtehaa'n hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sookhi zabaan asghar hoto'n pa pherte hai
ae hurmula teher jaa besheer neemjaa'n hai
taaboot jis ki maa ka aghyaar ne na dekha
karbal me uski beti paabande reesmaa'n hai
